title: Heard through the eye.
note: A frog's iris read as heat, with the prompt itself rippling off it in rings of monospaced type.
process: [[Flora: Nano Banana Pro]] made the macro photograph of the frog's eye at 4K. [[Claude Code]] cropped it to the iris and remapped every pixel's brightness to a thermal ironbow palette in [[Canvas]], then set the prompt itself in [[Google Fonts]] IBM Plex Mono as fifteen rings around the eye, each bent by a waveform that grows as it travels outwards, cooling from white hot to violet.
keywords: detailed zoomed in photo of a frog's iris
audio effect coming off the eyeball
